title: Implement string compression and decompression in Rust
description: Greenfield Rust task: implement compress (run-length encode, emitting count+char when count>1 else just char) and decompress (expand count+char sequences back to original string).

required_artifacts: compress emits count only when count > 1 (single chars have no prefix)
decompress handles chars with no numeric prefix
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `cargo test` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
